elements.requirement: A court by or before which a person is convicted of an offence under section 29B relating to the display of written material, or an offence under section 29C, 29E or 29G, must order to be forfeited any written material or recording produced to the court and shown to its satisfaction to be written material or a recording to which the offence relates.
elements.quote: shall order to be forfeited any written material or recording produced to the court and shown to its satisfaction to be written material or a recording to which the offence relates

elements.requirement: An order made under section 29I does not take effect until the expiry of the ordinary time within which an appeal may be instituted or, where an appeal is duly instituted, until it is finally decided or abandoned.
elements.quote: shall not take effect— (a) until the expiry of the ordinary time within which an appeal may be instituted or, where an appeal is duly instituted, until it is finally decided or abandoned

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 29I(2)(a), an application for a case stated or for leave to appeal must be treated as the institution of an appeal.
elements.quote: an application for a case stated or for leave to appeal shall be treated as the institution of an appeal

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 29I(2)(a), where a decision on appeal is subject to a further appeal, the appeal is not finally determined until the expiry of the ordinary time within which a further appeal may be instituted or, where a further appeal is duly instituted, until the further appeal is finally decided or abandoned.
elements.quote: where a decision on appeal is subject to a further appeal, the appeal is not finally determined until the expiry of the ordinary time within which a further appeal may be instituted or, where a further appeal is duly instituted, until the further appeal is finally decided or abandoned
